notes.title: We hear you!
notes.content:
🚀 Exciting News! 

You asked, we listened! 

We've just released a new version of Die Last, packed with optimizations and fixes! Check out the new features:

- Mute Sounds Button
- Improved SDK Config
- SDK Retries
- Smoother Gameplay (no more relogging, just a route reset)

Your sound might be off, but ours is always on for you and your feedback! Keep sharing your awesome ideas and enjoy the game with the new features 🌎

notes.title: Die Last Playtest
notes.content:
🧩 During this playtest, all participants will be able to test the very first game build. The testing will show only a small part of the game: digging and crafting Lost Objects, shards of the forgotten civilization. However, testing this functionality is very important, and there's a lot of work behind it.

Currently, the playtest build is being verified on Steam. Once Steam is verified, you'll be able to download the game and start playing. Meanwhile:

1. Please ensure you've added the game to your wishlist

2. Find out the "Join the Die Last Playtest" caption and click on the "Request Access" button

👉 https://twitter.com/playdielast

👉 https://discord.gg/dielast


✅ Join now for a chance to be part of this thrilling journey!
